summary: In a dry canyon in what is now New Mexico, Ancestral Puebloan people begin building 'great houses', huge multi-story stone buildings such as Pueblo Bonito, with hundreds of rooms and round ceremonial chambers called kivas. Chaco grows into a center linked by straight roads to settlements across the region.
significance: Chaco was the largest center of the ancient American Southwest until its decline in the 1100s, and modern Pueblo peoples regard it as an ancestral place.

zh.title: 查科峡谷的大型建筑
zh.summary: 今新墨西哥州的查科峡谷中，祖先普韦布洛人开始建造“大屋”，例如普韦布洛博尼托。这些多层石构建筑拥有数百房间与称为基瓦的圆形仪式空间，并以笔直道路连接周围聚落。
zh.significance: 查科曾是古代美国西南地区最大的中心，12世纪衰落。今日普韦布洛族群仍将其视为祖先之地。
zh.locationName: 查科峡谷普韦布洛博尼托

title: Gunpowder discovered
summary: Chinese Taoist alchemists, possibly searching for an elixir of immortality, find that mixing saltpeter, sulfur and charcoal makes a mixture that burns fiercely. A text often dated to the mid-9th century warns that such mixtures can burn the hands and face, but the date of the discovery is uncertain.
significance: By the 10th century gunpowder was used in Chinese warfare; it later spread across Asia and to Europe, where guns and cannons transformed war and the power of states.

zh.title: 火药的发现
zh.summary: 中国道教炼丹者可能在寻找长生药时，发现硝石、硫磺与木炭混合后会猛烈燃烧。一部常被定为9世纪中叶的文献警告，这类混合物可能烧伤手脸，但火药的确切发现年代未定。
zh.significance: 10世纪时，火药已用于中国战争，后来传遍亚洲并进入欧洲。火枪与火炮改变了战争及国家力量。
zh.locationName: 唐朝中国（以长安为代表地点）

title: Hunayn records his translations of Galen
summary: Hunayn ibn Ishaq writes an account of translations of Galen's medical works, later revised. He describes manuscripts, earlier versions and the work of translating between Greek, Syriac and Arabic.
significance: His work shows the scholarly care behind the transfer of ancient medicine into the Arabic-speaking world.

zh.title: 侯奈因记述盖伦著作翻译
zh.summary: 侯奈因·伊本·伊斯哈格撰写并随后修订盖伦医学著作翻译记述，说明手稿、旧译本，以及希腊语、叙利亚语与阿拉伯语之间的翻译工作。
zh.significance: 他的工作展示了古代医学传入阿拉伯语世界背后的严谨学术实践。

title: Diamond Sutra, oldest dated printed book

location.name: Mogao Caves, Dunhuang (where it was found)

summary: A Chinese copy of the Diamond Sutra, a Buddhist scripture, is printed from carved wooden blocks onto a paper scroll about 5 meters long. A note at its end says a man named Wang Jie had it made for his parents in the year corresponding to 868. Sealed in a cave at Dunhuang, it was found in 1900.
significance: It is the oldest known printed book with a date, showing that woodblock printing was already a mature craft in Tang China.

zh.title: 《金刚经》：现存最早有明确纪年的印刷书籍
zh.summary: 一部汉文《金刚经》以雕版印在约5米长的纸卷上，卷末题记说明王玠于868年为父母敬造。它被封藏于敦煌洞窟，1900年重新发现。
zh.significance: 这是已知最早带有明确纪年的印刷书籍，表明唐代雕版印刷已相当成熟。

title: Kievan Rus
summary: According to the Primary Chronicle, the Varangian prince Oleg seized Kiev in 882 and joined it to Novgorod, uniting the East Slavic lands along the river routes between the Baltic and Byzantium. Prince Vladimir adopted Orthodox Christianity from Constantinople in 988. The state later split into rival principalities, and the Mongols destroyed Kiev in 1240.
significance: Kievan Rus is the common ancestor of Russia, Ukraine and Belarus, and its choice of Orthodoxy tied the East Slavs to the Byzantine world.

zh.title: 基辅罗斯
zh.summary: 传统记载，882年瓦良格王公奥列格占领基辅，与诺夫哥罗德结合，控制波罗的海通往拜占庭的河运。988年弗拉基米尔接受东正教，后来诸国分裂，1240年基辅被蒙古摧毁。
zh.significance: 基辅罗斯是俄罗斯、乌克兰和白俄罗斯的共同历史源头，其宗教选择将东斯拉夫世界与拜占庭联系起来。

title: Al-Razi distinguishes smallpox and measles
summary: The physician al-Razi writes a careful account distinguishing smallpox from measles, conventionally dated around 900. His descriptions emphasize observation of symptoms and the course of illness.
significance: The treatise became an influential example of clinical description in medicine across linguistic and religious boundaries.

zh.title: 拉齐区分天花与麻疹
zh.summary: 医生拉齐撰文细致区分天花与麻疹，通常定于约900年。他强调对症状与病程的观察。
zh.significance: 这部论著成为跨越语言与宗教界限、具有影响力的临床描述范例。

title: Classic Maya collapse
summary: Over the 8th and 9th centuries, the great Maya cities of the southern lowlands, such as Tikal, Copan and Palenque, stop raising dated monuments, their kings disappear and most of their people move away. The causes are debated; leading explanations include severe droughts, endless warfare and overuse of the land.
significance: Maya civilization did not end: cities in the northern Yucatan such as Chichen Itza flourished afterward, and millions of Maya people live in the region today.

zh.title: 玛雅古典文明衰落
zh.summary: 8至9世纪，蒂卡尔、科潘、帕伦克等南部低地玛雅城市停止立碑，王权瓦解，人口大减。严重干旱、战争和土地过度利用是主要解释，具体原因仍有争论。
zh.significance: 玛雅文明并未终结，尤卡坦北部城市随后继续繁荣，今日仍有数百万玛雅人生活于该地区。

title: Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms
summary: After the Tang dynasty fell, five short-lived dynasties followed one another in northern China while some ten independent kingdoms divided the south and the far north. The Khitan Liao took the land around modern Beijing in this period, and the wars ended only when the Song reunited most of the country.
significance: The old Tang aristocracy was destroyed in these decades, clearing the way for the Song dynasty's government by examination-trained officials.

zh.title: 五代十国
zh.summary: 唐亡后，北方相继出现五个短命王朝，南方和北部边缘则分立着约十个政权。契丹辽在此期间取得今北京一带，直到宋统一大部分地区，长期战争才告一段落。
zh.significance: 旧唐贵族在这一时期衰亡，为宋朝以科举官僚为核心的政治秩序扫清了道路。

title: Fatimid Caliphate
summary: The Fatimids, a Shia dynasty claiming descent from the Prophet's daughter Fatima, took power in what is now Tunisia in 909 and conquered Egypt in 969, where they founded Cairo as their capital. At their height they ruled North Africa, Sicily, Syria and the holy cities of Arabia. Saladin abolished the caliphate in 1171.
significance: The Fatimids were the only major Shia caliphate, and they made Cairo, with its Al-Azhar mosque and school, a center of the Islamic world.

zh.title: 法蒂玛王朝
zh.summary: 自称先知之女法蒂玛后裔的什叶派王朝于909年在今突尼斯兴起，969年征服埃及并建开罗。极盛时控制北非、西西里、叙利亚与圣城，1171年被萨拉丁终结。
zh.significance: 这是主要的什叶派哈里发政权，开罗及爱资哈尔成为伊斯兰世界的重要中心。

title: Liao dynasty
summary: The Khitan, a nomadic people of Manchuria, were united by Abaoji and built an empire reaching from Mongolia to northern China, including the region of modern Beijing. They ruled their nomad and Chinese subjects under separate systems of law and forced the Song dynasty to pay an annual tribute after 1005.
significance: The Liao pioneered the dual government later used by the Jin, Yuan and Qing; the old Western name for China, Cathay, comes from the word Khitan.

zh.title: 辽朝
zh.summary: 阿保机统一满洲地区的游牧民族契丹，建立横跨蒙古高原与中国北方的帝国，包括今北京地区。辽以不同制度治理游牧与汉地人口，1005年后宋每年向辽支付岁币。
zh.significance: 辽开创了后被金、元、清沿用的双重治理模式。西方对中国的旧称 Cathay 源于“契丹”。

title: Goryeo
summary: Wang Geon founded Goryeo and reunited the Korean Peninsula in 936. The kingdom was strongly Buddhist, famous for its pale green celadon pottery, and it carved the Buddhist canon onto wooden blocks and pioneered printing with metal type. It survived Khitan invasions but became a vassal of the Mongols in the 13th century.
significance: Goryeo held Korea together for nearly five centuries, and its name is the source of the word Korea.

zh.title: 高丽
zh.summary: 王建建立高丽，于936年重新统一朝鲜半岛。高丽崇奉佛教，以青瓷闻名，将佛经雕刻于木版，并开创金属活字印刷。它抵挡契丹入侵，却在13世纪成为蒙古的附属国。
zh.significance: 高丽维系统一近五百年，英文 Korea 即源于其国名。

title: Kingdom of England
summary: Athelstan brought the Anglo-Saxon kingdoms under one crown in 927. The Normans conquered the kingdom in 1066, and over the following centuries its kings were forced to share power with Parliament, a process settled by civil war and the revolution of 1688. In 1707 England united with Scotland as Great Britain.
significance: England's common law and parliamentary government were carried around the world by the empire that grew out of it.

zh.title: 英格兰王国
zh.summary: 927年，埃塞尔斯坦将盎格鲁-撒克逊诸国统一。1066年诺曼征服后，王权逐步与议会分享权力，经历内战和1688年革命。1707年英格兰与苏格兰合为大不列颠。
zh.significance: 普通法与议会制度随后通过大英帝国传播到世界各地。

title: Cordoba claims a caliphate
summary: Abd al-Rahman III assumes the title of caliph in al-Andalus, asserting independence from rival caliphal claims. Cordoba becomes the center of a powerful western Islamic court.
significance: The caliphate fostered urban prosperity and scholarship while reshaping power in Iberia and the western Mediterranean.

zh.title: 科尔多瓦宣布建立哈里发国
zh.summary: 阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼三世在安达卢斯采用哈里发称号，主张独立于其他哈里发权威。科尔多瓦成为强大的西部伊斯兰宫廷中心。
zh.significance: 哈里发国促进城市繁荣与学术，并改变伊比利亚及西地中海的权力格局。

title: Song dynasty
summary: The Song reunited most of China and governed it through officials chosen by examination. Its cities and commerce boomed and it issued the first government paper money, but it lost the north to the Jurchen Jin in 1127 and fell to the Mongols in 1279.
significance: Song China was the most economically and technologically advanced society of its time, bringing printing, gunpowder weapons and the compass into wide use.

zh.title: 宋朝
zh.summary: 宋统一中国大部分地区，通过科举官员治理国家。城市与商业繁荣，并发行最早的政府纸币。1127年北方失于女真金朝，1279年南宋又亡于蒙古。
zh.significance: 宋是当时经济和科技最发达的社会之一，印刷、火药武器和指南针得到广泛应用。

title: Holy Roman Empire
summary: Beginning with the coronation of Otto I, the empire was a union of German, Italian, Bohemian and other lands under an elected emperor. Over the centuries its princes, bishops and free cities gained near-independence, and Napoleon's victories brought it to an end in 1806.
significance: For more than eight centuries it shaped the politics of central Europe, and its loose structure is one reason Germany and Italy became unified nations only in the 19th century.

zh.title: 神圣罗马帝国
zh.summary: 从奥托一世加冕起，帝国涵盖德意志、意大利、波希米亚等地，由选举产生的皇帝领导。诸侯、主教与自由城市逐渐获得高度自主，帝国最终于1806年解体。
zh.significance: 它塑造中欧八百余年，其分权结构也是德意志与意大利较晚统一的原因之一。

title: Dai Viet
summary: After a thousand years of Chinese rule, the Vietnamese of the Red River delta secured their independence in the 10th century. Under the Ly, Tran and Le dynasties the kingdom repelled Song, Mongol and Ming invasions, governed through Confucian examinations, and expanded steadily southward at the expense of Champa. It was renamed Vietnam in 1804.
significance: Dai Viet kept Vietnam independent of China while adopting much of its statecraft, and gave the country its present shape.

zh.title: 大越
zh.summary: 越南人在经历约千年中国统治后于10世纪独立。李、陈、黎等王朝抵抗宋、蒙古与明的进攻，采用儒家官僚制度，并不断向占婆领土南扩，1804年改国号为越南。
zh.significance: 大越在借鉴中国国家制度的同时保持独立，并逐步形成今日越南的疆域。

title: Ghaznavid Empire
summary: The Ghaznavids were a dynasty of Turkic slave soldiers who made themselves rulers at Ghazni in what is now Afghanistan. Under Mahmud, who raided northern India seventeen times, the empire stretched from Iran to the Punjab, and his court patronized the poet Ferdowsi and the scholar al-Biruni.
significance: The Ghaznavids opened northern India to Muslim rule and set the pattern of Turkic armies ruling through Persian culture.

zh.title: 加兹尼王朝
zh.summary: 突厥奴隶军人出身的加兹尼王朝，以今阿富汗加兹尼为中心。马哈茂德屡次进攻北印度，疆域横跨伊朗至旁遮普，宫廷扶持菲尔多西与比鲁尼等学者。
zh.significance: 它为穆斯林进入北印度铺路，并确立突厥军事精英结合波斯文化的统治模式。

title: Rajaraja Chola expands the Chola Empire
summary: Rajaraja I becomes king of the Cholas of Tamil Nadu and conquers neighboring kingdoms in southern India, northern Sri Lanka and the Maldives, using a strong navy. At his capital Thanjavur he builds the Brihadisvara Temple, completed around 1010.
significance: Under Rajaraja and his son Rajendra I, the Chola Empire became the leading power of southern India and the Bay of Bengal, spreading Tamil culture and trade across the sea to Southeast Asia.

zh.title: 罗阇罗阇扩张朱罗王朝
zh.summary: 罗阇罗阇一世即位后，以强大海军和军队征服南印度邻国、斯里兰卡北部及马尔代夫，并在首都坦贾武尔建造约1010年完工的大寺。
zh.significance: 他与其子拉金德拉一世使朱罗成为南印度和孟加拉湾的主导力量，将泰米尔文化与贸易扩展到东南亚。

title: Kingdom of France
summary: When Hugh Capet was elected king in 987 he controlled little beyond Paris. His descendants slowly brought the great duchies under the crown, drove the English out in the Hundred Years' War, and by the reign of Louis XIV had made France the strongest and most centralized monarchy in Europe. The Revolution abolished the monarchy in 1792.
significance: France was the leading power of medieval and early modern Europe, and its language and court set the fashion for the continent.

zh.title: 法兰西王国
zh.summary: 987年于格·卡佩即位时，直接控制范围仅略超巴黎。后代逐步收服大诸侯，百年战争中逐走英军，至路易十四时形成强大中央集权君主国，1792年被革命推翻。
zh.significance: 法国长期是欧洲主要强国，其语言与宫廷文化成为大陆各国效仿的典范。

title: Kingdom of Hungary
summary: Stephen I, a descendant of the Magyar chiefs who had settled the Danube plain, was crowned a Christian king in 1000. The kingdom became one of the largest in medieval Europe, survived a Mongol invasion in 1241, and held the Ottoman advance for a century before its army was destroyed at Mohacs in 1526.
significance: Hungary was the shield of central Europe against the Ottomans; after 1526 it was divided between them and the Habsburgs.

zh.title: 匈牙利王国
zh.summary: 定居多瑙河平原的马扎尔首领后裔伊什特万一世于1000年加冕为基督教国王。匈牙利成长为中世纪欧洲大国，经历蒙古入侵，并长期抵抗奥斯曼，直到1526年莫哈奇惨败。
zh.significance: 匈牙利是中欧抵御奥斯曼的重要屏障，1526年后领土被奥斯曼与哈布斯堡等势力分割。

title: Norse reach Vinland
summary: Norse sailors from the settlements in Greenland, led according to Icelandic sagas by Leif Erikson, reach a land they call Vinland on the coast of North America. At L'Anse aux Meadows, in Newfoundland, archaeologists have found a Norse camp, possibly the Vinland of the sagas, including wood cut with metal tools that a tree-ring study dates to 1021. They do not stay long.
significance: It was the first known European contact with the Americas, nearly five centuries before Columbus, though it left no lasting settlement.

zh.title: 北欧人抵达文兰
zh.summary: 格陵兰的北欧航海者抵达北美沿岸，称之为文兰；冰岛萨迦将旅程归于莱夫·埃里克松。纽芬兰兰塞奥兹牧草地发现北欧营地，可能对应传说中的文兰，其中经金属工具砍伐的木材被树轮研究定为1021年。定居并未持续很久。
zh.significance: 这是已知最早的欧洲与美洲接触，比哥伦布早近五百年，但没有形成持久殖民地。
zh.locationName: 纽芬兰兰塞奥兹牧草地

title: Polynesians settle Hawaii
summary: Polynesian voyagers, probably from the Marquesas or Society Islands, sail thousands of kilometers across open ocean in double-hulled canoes and settle the Hawaiian Islands, bringing crops such as taro and animals such as pigs. The timing is debated: older estimates placed it several centuries earlier, but recent radiocarbon studies point to around 1000 to 1200.
significance: The settlement of Hawaii was one of the great feats of navigation without instruments, part of the Polynesian expansion that reached nearly every habitable island of the Pacific.

zh.title: 波利尼西亚人定居夏威夷
zh.summary: 波利尼西亚人可能从马克萨斯或社会群岛乘双体独木舟抵达夏威夷，携带芋头、猪等动植物。年代仍有争论，近年的碳测年倾向约1000至1200年。
zh.significance: 这是无现代仪器远洋导航的杰出成就，也是波利尼西亚遍及太平洋宜居岛屿扩张的一部分。
